name: Łask County (Poland)
description: Three vertical stripes of yellow, red and yellow in the ratio 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the emblem of the county arms: a yellow mitre above crossed croziers and a bar between lion heads.
history: The current flag was established by resolution No. XXXVII/317/13 of the county council of 28 November 2013, replacing a first version adopted on 30 August 2002.

features.role: mitre, crozier and lions from the county arms
